basics.name: Claiderman Alexander Lozano Cardona
basics.label: Specialist in Serverless Backend & Cloud Architecture
basics.summary: Backend engineer with over 6 years of experience building scalable serverless systems and cloud architectures. Currently at Polygonus, I develop backends for video games and interactive applications, implementing serverless APIs on AWS Lambda that support thousands of concurrent users. My work spans from REST APIs and progression systems for games to audit systems for the financial sector, serving clients like Bancolombia, Banistmo, and Grupo Familia. Passionate about solving backend performance challenges and building systems that scale effortlessly. Growing in English proficiency and always learning new technologies.
basics.personalMission: I transform complex technical challenges into elegant serverless solutions. I believe a great backend should be scalable, maintainable, and virtually invisible to the user. I'm seeking to collaborate on innovative gaming or interactive applications where I can apply my expertise in cloud architectures and TypeScript. Always open to discussing how I can add value to your team.

work.name: Polygonus

Optimizes performance of critical services in high-load environments. Participates in development and maintenance of web platform + LMS for digital arts, game development and AI training. Develops APIs with Python (FastAPI) for educational platforms, achieving <100ms latency on 95% of requests

Optimizes PostgreSQL databases and Redis caching systems, improving performance by 40% and reducing costs by 30%
Implements CloudWatch monitoring and alerts, detecting and resolving bottlenecks before impacting users

projects.name: Educational Platform
projects.description: Development of an educational platform for the Polygonus academy, implementing a system that supports multiple concurrent users with good response times.

projects.name: Panafutbol - Football Game with Rewards
projects.description: Developed a REST API for a football knockout game with a reward system where players earn attempts by redeeming supermarket bills. Implemented a leaderboard for prizes and real-time score synchronization. The API is consumed by a Unity WebGL3 client.

caseStudy.challenge: Create a backend system handling massive traffic spikes during supermarket promotions when thousands of users simultaneously attempt to redeem physical bills. The system needed to integrate physical receipts with a real-time digital rewards system.
caseStudy.solution: Implemented a serverless API using AWS Lambda with API Gateway, PostgreSQL for user profiles and scores, and SQS queues for asynchronous bill redemption processing. Implemented Redis caching for real-time leaderboard display.
results: Supports 5000+ concurrent users during promotion peaks

projects.name: Fanta Runner
projects.description: Developed a REST API for a runner-type game, designed specifically to be consumed by a Unity WebGL3 client. Implemented scoring systems, difficulty progression and real-time data synchronization with serverless backend.

projects.name: Dprimero Runner
projects.description: Developed a runner-type game with Nordic and cold environment where players must dodge barrels and fences. Implemented scoring systems, difficulty progression and real-time data synchronization with serverless backend.

projects.name: Agents of the Mundane
projects.description: Developed an educational game with gamification that integrates questions and answers to improve the learning experience. Implemented a serverless architecture that manages user progression and stores results for performance analysis.

projects.name: Game Server

projects.name: Futureverse Discord Bot
projects.description: Developed a Discord bot that integrates events from the TNL and Raicers games. Implemented a Factory and Event-Driven pattern that processes SQS messages and distributes them to different services based on event type, keeping the community informed about game updates and events in real time.

projects.name: The Next Legends (TNL) - AI Boxing Game
projects.description: Developed the backend for an innovative AI-powered boxing game where players train virtual boxers and compete in real-time battles. Implemented a serverless architecture managing user profiles, multiplayer matches, and character progression systems with integrated NFTs.

caseStudy.challenge: Create a backend system supporting real-time player battles with low latency while managing NFT character assets and digital rewards. The primary challenge was maintaining state consistency across multiple devices and synchronizing combat animations.
caseStudy.solution: Designed an AWS Lambda-based architecture with Step Functions for match orchestration, and DynamoDB for state persistence. Implemented WebSockets via API Gateway for real-time communication. Integrated subgraph for NFT management and reward distribution.
results: Supports 500+ concurrent players with <50ms combat latency
Scalable architecture reduced costs by 40% vs monolithic solution
Feature deployment time reduced to <1 day with CI/CD pipelines
